claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up's prose comes to roughly 285-290 words by manual count, so the stated length is accurate within normal rounding.

message_source_quote: The approach adapts the "white-bear steering" idea from Raman et al. 2026 (found in `papers/raman2026-white-bear-steering.md`) to Qwen3.5-4B
writeup_source_quote: following the dose recipe of Raman et al. (2026, white-bear steering on Qwen3.6-27B)
rationale: Both documents credit Raman et al. 2026's white-bear steering as the basis the method adapts, and both describe the same contrast construction and application recipe, so the level of attribution to the source is essentially equal (credits/credits). The main difference is that the write-up explicitly states two specific design choices (the layer band mapping and prefix-only placement) are new relative to the paper and 'differ from the paper,' making the novelty boundary explicit, whereas the message reports the same findings as neutral 'Key findings' of the run without flagging them as departures from the source, so the message conveys slightly less about the method's novelty relative to the write-up.
